sentinel.title: Sentinel Key Points
items: Press {Takedown} with a {Wildfire Bomb} charge in reserve. Put a bomb into the {Sentinel's Mark} applied by {Lunar Calling}, and throw {Moonlight Chakram} within 15 seconds
Time the {Don't Look Back} shield from consuming {Sentinel's Mark} right before big AoE damage

pack-leader.title: Pack Leader Key Points
items: {Takedown} summons a beast instantly via {Stampede!}, so line it up with big pulls and boss burst windows
{Kill Command} and {Raptor Strike} reduce the beast cooldown via {Dire Summons}, so keep consuming {Tip of the Spear}

Rav'i: [광역 피해] When the Ssscavenging shield goes up, pour Takedown and Boomstick into the shield (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Ravenous Stomp's party damage (Topicx)

[해제] If Regurgitate (Disease) hits you, press Feign Death to clear both the slow and the 50% damage dealt reduction with Emergency Salve. If Feign Death is on cooldown, clear just the slow with Disengage (Posthaste)
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Muzzle (15 sec) into the 3-kick Toxic Atrophy rotation
[위치] During Death Rattle, snap the Vine Grip right away with Disengage (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] When Uncoil splits the boss into 5 Writhes, use Takedown with Bloodlust (Topicx), throw Wildfire Bomb cones to cut Boomstick's cooldown, then fire Boomstick into the gathered Writhes. If the group has no Bloodlust class, use your Ferocity pet's Primal Rage

[제어] Tether Uncoiled Writhes moving toward their Spiteful Hunt target with Binding Shot (Sentinel build) (Wowhead). If Spiteful Venom (Poison) stacks build up, trigger Emergency Salve with Feign Death to clear them
Zul'jan: [참고] Block a Ritual of the Fang beam for a few seconds, then Feign Death to stop one beam (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] If Ritual Venom stacks up during the Ritual of the Fang channel and your health is low, use Survival of the Fittest

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt does not need a set kick rotation. Kick it when Muzzle is available (Topicx)
[회피] If you are targeted by Thornblade, you can block the bleed with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[위치] During Lightblossom Beam, step into the Fertile Loam to block the beam, and when the beam ends, leave the pool with Disengage (Posthaste) to clear the 50% slow
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] If you are rooted by Bloodthorn Roots, free yourself with Disengage (Posthaste), and with a Cunning pet free an ally with Master's Call (Wowhead)
[회피] If you are targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze, you can drop the chase with Feign Death. Do not use it if more roots still need to be broken (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] Use one Survival of the Fittest charge on Thorncaller Roar and save the other for Lightcrazed Frenzy after 50%. Bloodlust goes below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active, so line up Takedown with it (Topicx)
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Muzzle into the kick rotation for Warden's Wrath during Moonkin Form

[위치] If you are marked by Pulverizing Strikes, stand still and aim the cone away from the group. If the Grievous Thrash bleed is still on you, top off with Exhilaration before the cone to clear the bleed, or block the bleed entirely with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Save both Survival of the Fittest charges for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Kick the Lashers' Lightspore Shot with Muzzle before they revive
[참고] Do not soak Lightbloom's Essence orbs with Aspect of the Turtle active. It blocks the Lightbloom's Might damage increase (Wowhead)
[위치] Do not Disengage backward near the right edge of the platform. Backing all the way to the edge pulls the Overgrown Hydra (Topicx)

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Clear the Toxic Spores poison yourself with Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle (Emergency Salve). During Aspect of the Turtle you can run over several mushrooms (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for the Ravenous Bellow physical AoE
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] As a melee spec, Survival takes the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss, so put Muzzle into that add's Winter's Shroud rotation. If the ranged-side add's cast gets missed, stop it with Intimidation, which has 100 yard range (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest during the Frozen Tempest raid-wide DoT
Nalorakk: [위치] During Fury of the War God, Aspect of the Turtle lets you block multiple Echo of Nalorakk without gaining Spectral Slash (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Echoing Maul, use one Survival of the Fittest charge when the Echo lands (Topicx), and save the other for Overwhelming Onslaught's three armor-ignoring Physical hits
[광역 피해] If the third Bloodlust was saved for this boss (Topicx), line up Takedown with it

Kystia Manaheart: [제어] Stop the Mirror Images clones with Intimidation and Freezing Trap, and interrupt Felstorm with Muzzle (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Hold Takedown for the Destabilized window, and move Hunter's Mark to the target you're hitting (Nibbles, Kystia) (Wowhead)
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The second Bloodlust goes as soon as the boss comes out (Topicx), so line up Takedown and Boomstick once the worker pack and the boss are stacked. Remove Keen Taskmaster's Back to Work! Enrage with Tranquilizing Shot (Wowhead)
[회피] You can block Murder in a Row with Aspect of the Turtle even without a barrel (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Killing Spree's armor-ignoring AoE
Xathuux the Annihilator: [회피] Block the Infernal Crush DoT with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Line up Takedown with Demonic Rage, when the boss takes 30% more damage, and on the second Demonic Rage the third Bloodlust goes out, so use Boomstick with it too (Topicx)
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Take a slot in the Chaos Bolt rotation with Muzzle
[위치] You can cross Malefic Wave safely with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[제어] Tether the Wild Imps gathered by Fingers of Gul'dan with Binding Shot (Sentinel build) and kill them with Wildfire Bomb and Boomstick

Taz'Rah: [회피] If you moved away to dodge Void Fissure orbs, Harpoon straight back to the boss to cut DPS downtime
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for the Dark Bloom shadow AoE
Atroxus: [해제] Clear Poison Splash and Mind-Numbing Poison from yourself with Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle (Emergency Salve, Wowhead)

[우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out when the first Toxic Creeper appears (Topicx), so line up Takedown with it, throw Wildfire Bomb with the Creeper as the primary target, then catch the boss in the Boomstick cone too
Charonus: [회피] Block the 20 sec Cosmic Crash DoT with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[위치] If you are targeted by Gravitic Orbs, as a melee spec drag the orb to one of the 2 nearby Unstable Singularities (Topicx). Clear the Condensed Mass slow with Disengage (Posthaste) (Wowhead)
[회피] If you are targeted by Void Cascade, keep running in one direction away from the group (Topicx). You can also cancel the cast with Feign Death (Wowhead)

The Golden Serpent: [제어] Tether Animated Gold with Binding Shot (Sentinel build) to slow its approach to the boss (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Put Wildfire Bomb and Boomstick into stacked Animated Gold
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Muzzle into the Wretched Discharge rotation for Half-Finished Mummies and Finished Mummies, and if you miss it and get the disease, clear it yourself with Feign Death (Emergency Salve, Wowhead)
[회피] If you are targeted by Drain Fluids, you can cancel it with Feign Death (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on this boss (Topicx), so use Takedown and Boomstick with Bloodlust at the start, and use Primal Rage if the group has no Bloodlust class
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] The longer Kula lives, the more Whirling Axes pile up, so pour Takedown and Boomstick into Kula and kill it before the fourth set of axes (Topicx)
[위치] Aka'ali's Barrel Through can be canceled with Feign Death or soaked alone with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[차단] Put Muzzle into Zanazal's Poison Nova rotation, and if you miss it and get the poison, clear it yourself with Feign Death (Emergency Salve)
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out at the start of Dazar, so pour Takedown and Boomstick into Reban and kill it before 80% (Topicx)
[차단] Put Muzzle into Reban's Deathly Roar rotation
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Gilded Destruction's burst AoE, and survive the 15 sec DoT with Exhilaration

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands (Topicx), so use Muzzle only when the tank misses it
[위치] If you are targeted by Chillstorm, place the storm and then Disengage out of it quickly (Wowhead)
[제어] Tether the intermission Infused Whelps with Binding Shot (Sentinel build) to cut down their Cold Claws melee attacks (Wowhead)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Muzzle into the Blaze Volley rotation for Blazebound Firestorm
[참고] Using Feign Death right before Blazebound Firestorm's Inferno cast finishes prevents its damage (Wowhead)
[우선 처치] The Firestorm must die before the next Molten Boulder (Topicx), so use Takedown and Boomstick on it, and Disengage out when it casts Burnout (5 sec cast, 20 yards) on death
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [우선 처치] When Kyrakka comes down, Harpoon to it and use Takedown
[광역 피해] Save Takedown and Boomstick for the start of phase 2, and after the merge use them on the boss with lower health (Topicx)

[위치] If you are targeted by Inferno Spit, place the circle at the edge toward the next Winds of Change direction, and use Survival of the Fittest when the 6 sec DoT ends and explodes in 8 yards (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [참고] When Storm Blessed moves, move Hunter's Mark to the boss without immunity (the one the tank marked with a skull) (Wowhead·Topicx)
[위치] If Gale Force pushes you away, Harpoon right back to the skull-marked boss. You can soak Thunder and Lightning alone with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
Merektha: [제어] Free allies caught in A Knot of Snakes with Intimidation or Freezing Trap. If you are caught yourself, drop Freezing Trap under your feet and stay still to break free (Wowhead)
[차단] Kick Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Muzzle, and if it hits you, clear the poison yourself with Feign Death (Emergency Salve, Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Serpentstorm's party AoE (Topicx). After Hatch, once the tank has aggro on the Storm Serpent, use Takedown and Boomstick on it
Galvazzt: [광역 피해] If Galvanized stacks up while blocking the Lightning Spire beam, use Survival of the Fittest
[위치] Move quickly with Aspect of the Cheetah during beam swaps
Avatar of Sethraliss: [위치] Corrupted Lifeforce can be soaked back-to-back with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[제어] Tether phase 2 Faithless Tormentors with Binding Shot (Sentinel build) to slow their chase on the healer (Wowhead)
[차단] Interrupt the Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock with Muzzle

781.d: 뒤로 물러납니다. [급가속: 이동 방해 효과가 제거되고, 이동 속도가 4초 동안 0%만큼 증가합니다] [위기 모면: 거미줄 덫을 놓아, 8미터 반경 내의 모든 대상이 끈적이는 거미줄에 걸려 8초 동안 이동하지 못하게 만듭니다]

982.d: 야수가 기본 생명력의 100%를 지닌 채 되살아나게 합니다.

1543.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간
1543.d: 20초 동안 대상 지역 안에 있는 은신이나 투명 상태의 적을 모두 감지합니다.

5384.d: 적을 속여 자신이 죽은 것처럼 보이게 만듭니다. 최대 6분 동안 지속됩니다.

19577.m: 특성 · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
19577.d: 적을 위협하도록 야수에게 명령합니다. 5초 동안 대상을 기절시킵니다.

19801.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
19801.d: 적에게서 1개의 격노 효과와 1개의 마법 효과를 제거합니다.

34477.m: 특성 · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
34477.d: 자신이 생성하는 모든 위협 수준을 대상 파티원 또는 공격대원에게 이전합니다. 30초 이내에 실시하는 자신의 다음 공격으로부터 시작되며, 8초 동안 지속됩니다.

53480.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
53480.d:
야수가 아군 대상을 보호하여 받는 피해를 15%만큼 감소시키지만, 대상이 받는 모든 피해의 50%가 야수에게 이전됩니다.

10초 동안 혹은 야수의 생명력이 25% 미만으로 떨어질 때까지 지속됩니다.

109215.d: 철수 사용 시 모든 이동 방해 효과가 제거되고, 이동 속도가 4초 동안 50%만큼 증가합니다.

109248.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
109248.d: 마력이 담긴 투사체를 발사하여 투사체로부터 5미터 반경 내의 적들을 10초 동안 구속합니다. 적이 화살에서 5미터 이상 떨어질 경우 3초 동안 기절시킵니다. [억제의 족쇄: 구속의 사격으로 기절 상태가 된 대상의 효과가 사라지면 8초 동안 대상에게 받는 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다]

109304.m: 45 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
109304.d: 자신의 생명력이 30%만큼, 야수의 생명력이 최대 생명력의 100%만큼 회복됩니다. [원기 회복의 바람: 활기 시전 시 8초에 걸쳐 최대 생명력의 12.0%만큼 추가로 생명력을 회복합니다]

186257.d: 3초 동안 이동 속도가 90%만큼 증가합니다. 효과가 만료되면 추가로 9초 동안 이동 속도가 30%만큼 증가합니다.

186265.d: 8초 동안 모든 주문과 공격이 빗나가고, 받는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다. 단, 공격할 수 없게 됩니다.

186270.d: 잔인하게 적을 공격하여 (전투력의 393.25%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

187650.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
187650.d: 목표 위치로 냉기 덫을 발사합니다. 적이 다가오면 1분 동안 행동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 받으면 효과가 사라집니다. 한 번에 하나만 사용할 수 있으며, 덫은 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

187707.m: 특성 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
187707.d: 주문 시전을 차단하고 5초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하는 것을 방해합니다.

190925.m: 8 - 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
190925.d: 적에게 작살을 던져, 3초 동안 이동 불가 상태로 만들고 그쪽으로 이동합니다.

199921.d: 3초 동안 공격을 하지 않으면 이동 속도가 30%만큼 증가합니다.

257284.d:
대상에게 사냥꾼의 징표를 겁니다. 사냥꾼은 징표에 걸린 대상을 항상 볼 수 있고, 추적할 수 있습니다.

사냥꾼의 징표는 대상이 받는 피해를 3%만큼 증가시킵니다. 한 번에 한 대상에게만 부여할 수 있습니다.

259489.m: 특성 · 50 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 5 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
259489.d:
야수에게 살상 명령을 내려 적에게 흉포하게 (전투력의 300%)의 물리 피해를 입히게 합니다.

15 / 활기의 파동: 20 / 기습의 이점: 20의 집중을 생성합니다.

Increases the damage of your next non-Kill Command ability by 0%.

259495.m: 특성 · 집중 10 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 18 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
259495.d:
대상에게 폭탄을 던집니다. 폭탄은 폭발하며 부채꼴 범위 내 적들에게 (전투력의 190%)의 화염 피해를 입히고, 야생불로 뒤덮어 6초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 125.928%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

주 대상에게는 50%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

260248.d: 12미터 내에 있는 출혈 상태의 적 하나당 자신과 야수의 공격 속도가 10%만큼 증가합니다.

260285.d: 살상 명령 사용 시 다른 능력의 직접 피해를 15%만큼 증가시킵니다. 최대 3번까지 중첩됩니다.

264332.d: 야생불 폭탄이 2번 충전되며, 최초 폭발 공격력이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

264667.d:
40초 동안 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 가속을 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

효과를 받은 아군은 만족함 상태가 되어 10분 동안 원초적 분노 또는 유사 효과를 받지 못합니다.

264735.m: 특성 · 사정거리 없음 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
264735.d: 6초 동안 자신과 야수가 받는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다.

266921.d: 독수리의 상, 치타의 상, 거북의 상의 재사용 대기시간이 15초만큼 감소합니다.

272682.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
272682.d: 야수가 자신 및 아군 대상 1명에게 걸린 모든 이동 불가 및 이동 방해 효과를 제거하고, 4초 동안 야수와 대상이 유사한 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

378934.d:
자동 공격의 공격력이 25%만큼 증가합니다.

민첩성이 3%만큼 증가하며, 쌍수 무기를 사용하는 동안에는 추가로 1%만큼 증가합니다.

385539.d: 활기 시전 시 8초에 걸쳐 최대 생명력의 12.0%만큼 추가로 회복합니다.

450373.d: 파수꾼의 표식을 소모하면 최대 생명력의 10.0%에 해당하는 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 얻습니다.

459517.d: 죽은 척하기 및 거북의 상 사용 시 독과 질병 효과를 제거합니다.

459843.d: 붐스틱 사용 시 8초 동안 야생불 폭탄의 재사용 대기시간 회복 속도가 60%만큼 증가합니다.

459964.d: 살상 명령 사용 시 5의 집중을 추가로 생성하고 치명타 및 극대화율이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

460198.d:
살상 명령의 공격력이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

살상 명령이 야생불 폭탄의 재사용 대기시간을 1.0초만큼 감소시킵니다.

462036.d: 야생불 폭탄의 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

471876.d:
전투 중 30초마다 다음 살상 명령 사용 시 맹수를 소환하여 지원을 받습니다.

와이번
와이번이 하늘에서 내려와 전투의 함성을 내질러 12초 동안 사냥꾼과 야수의 공격력을 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.

멧돼지
멧돼지가 시전자의 대상에게 1회 돌진하여 주위의 적에게 (전투력의 1440%)의 피해를 입히고, 주 대상에게는 (전투력의 1200%)의 추가 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

곰
곰이 전투에 난입해 적을 찢어발깁니다. 주위에 있는 최대 8명의 적에게 10초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 400%)의 피해를 입힙니다.

472352.d:
살상 명령 사용 시 무리의 지도자의 포효의 재사용 대기시간이 1.5초만큼 감소합니다.

랩터의 일격 사용 시 무리의 지도자의 포효의 재사용 대기시간이 1.0초만큼 감소합니다.

(700밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

472550.d:
야수의 공격이 와이번의 공격력 증가량을 1%만큼, 최대 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.

야생불 폭탄 시전 시 와이번의 지속시간이 5.0초만큼, 최대 10초만큼 연장됩니다.

472639.d: 멧돼지가 피해를 입힐 때마다 다음 붐스틱의 공격력이 5%만큼, 최대 20%만큼 증가합니다.

472741.d:
제압 시전 시 무리의 지도자의 포효가 부여되고 다음 살상 명령이 주위의 야생동물을 자극해 쇄도를 일으켜, 대상에게 돌진해 7초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 150%) * 9]의 물리 피해를 입히게 합니다.

(5초 재사용 대기시간)

1250646.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
1250646.d:
시전자와 야수가 대상에게 도약해 동시에 공격을 날려 [(전투력의 600%) + (전투력의 1200%)]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 야수는 도약할 때 이동 불가 상태를 해제합니다.

다음 8초 동안 시전자와 야수가 입히는 피해가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

50의 집중을 생성합니다.

1251717.d:
창끝을 소모하면 야수가 자극을 받아 대상을 공격해 (전투력의 180%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

야수가 입히는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 증가합니다. (700밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1252708.d: 랩터의 일격 시전 시 8초 동안 랩터의 일격의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다. 여러 번 사용 시 효과가 중첩됩니다.

1252931.d:
단일 대상 공격 시 붐스틱의 공격력이 40%만큼 증가합니다.

추가 대상 하나당 이 추가 효과가 5%만큼 감소합니다.

1253053.d: 랩터의 일격 및 살상 명령 사용 시 치명타 및 극대화율이 10%만큼, 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 10%만큼 증가합니다.

1253137.d: 한마음 한뜻으로가 치명타 및 극대화로 적중하면 대상에게 출혈을 일으켜 5초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 40%)의 피해를 입힙니다.

1253172.d: 야생불 폭탄의 주기적인 효과가 출혈 효과가 되며, 3초에 걸쳐 사냥꾼과 야수에게 15의 집중을 부여합니다.

1253599.d:
창끝을 소모하면 10%의 확률로 파수꾼 올빼미를 소환합니다. 올빼미는 하늘에서 강하하여 대상에게 파수꾼의 표식을 부여합니다.

파수꾼의 표식
다음 야생불 폭탄 사용 시 징표가 남겨진 대상에게 40%의 추가 직접 피해

1253601.d: 다음 야생불 폭탄이 징표가 남겨진 대상에게 40%의 추가 직접 피해를 입힙니다.

1253732.d: 파수꾼의 표식을 소모할 때 달의 투사체 4개를 퍼부어 10미터 내의 적에게 (전투력의 200%)의 비전 피해를 입힙니다.

1253852.d: 제압이 파수꾼 올빼미를 소환하며, 제압의 지속시간 동안 파수꾼 올빼미를 소환할 확률이 10%만큼 추가로 증가합니다.

1257011.d: 랩터의 일격과 붐스틱의 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

1259019.d:
랩터의 일격 사용 시 랩터의 휩쓸기로 강화되어 전방 15미터 내의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 280%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

창끝의 효과를 받는 랩터의 휩쓸기는 300%의 효율로 한마음 한뜻으로를 발동시킵니다.

1261193.m: 특성 · 집중 50 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (3 초 주문 시전 시간) · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
1261193.d: 전방 20미터에 산탄총을 4회 연이어 발사해 3초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 607.5%) * 4]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1261229.d: 붐스틱으로 한 명 이상의 적에게 피해를 입히면 야생불 폭탄의 재사용 대기시간이 3.0초만큼 감소합니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1262409.d: 야생불 폭탄이 적중당한 대상 하나당 붐스틱의 재사용 대기시간을 2.0초만큼, 최대 10초만큼 감소시킵니다.

1264902.d:
제압 시전 후 15초 동안 제압이 달빛 회전 표창으로 대체됩니다.

달빛 회전 표창
현재 대상에게 달빛의 축복을 받은 회전 표창을 날려 빠르게 (전투력의 284.4%)의 물리 피해를 7번 입히고 주위에 다른 대상이 있으면 튕기게 합니다.

(1초 재사용 대기시간)

1272154.d:
살상 명령이 창끝 1중첩을 추가로 부여합니다.

창끝의 공격력 증가 효과가 5%만큼 증가합니다.

1: [해제] Hold the Minion of Zul on the way with Intimidation (1 min, 5 sec stun), and remove its Bound by Shadow shield (Magic) with Tranquilizing Shot (10 sec) to kill it right away (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] This is the dungeon's first pull, so Bloodlust goes out here (Topicx). Once the 2 Animated Guardians are dragged to the Shadow-Borne Champion pack and stacked, use Takedown (1.5 min) and Boomstick (1 min), and if the group has no Bloodlust class, use your Ferocity pet's Primal Rage (6 min).

[광역 피해] Take each Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yards) from Shadow-Borne Champion with Survival of the Fittest (1.5 min, 2 charges with Padded Armor) (Topicx). Remove the Champion's Ancestral Fury Enrage with Tranquilizing Shot (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 12 sec curse DoT) with Muzzle (15 sec), and stop Shadowfrost Bolt with Intimidation if you have time.

[광역 피해] The corner pack is a cooldown pull (Topicx). Throw both Wildfire Bomb charges, then Boomstick, and add Takedown if it is back. Take Shadow Whirlwind with your remaining Survival of the Fittest charge, or survive it with Exhilaration (1.5 min, heals 30% of max health) if no charge is left. Remove Ancestral Fury Enrage with Tranquilizing Shot (Wowhead).
4: [차단] Put Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (10 sec charm) and Soul Bolt and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending into your Muzzle rotation, and stop them with Intimidation while Muzzle is on cooldown. Remove Queen Patlaa's Bestial Berserk Enrage with Tranquilizing Shot (Wowhead).

[회피] If you are targeted by King Timalji's Bladestorm, cancel the chase with Feign Death (30 sec). When a Bloodsworn Assassin uses Sudden Rupture, stop it with Freezing Trap (30 sec) or Binding Shot (45 sec, Sentinel build) (Wowhead).

[우선 처치] Use Takedown and Boomstick only after the tank has aggro on the awakened pack, and save them for the hardest pack, King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins (Topicx). With a Cunning pet, put Mortal Wounds on King A'akul to cut the healing from Blood Drain (Wowhead).
5: [광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole party). If you use Bloodlust here at high keys, line up Takedown and Boomstick with it (Topicx).
[해제] If you are hit by Embalming Fluid's Putrid Seekers poison DoT (4 yards, 12 sec), clear it yourself with Feign Death (Emergency Salve).
6: [차단] Take one of the 2 Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease DoT on the whole party) with Muzzle (Topicx). If you miss it and get the disease, clear it yourself with Feign Death (Emergency Salve, Wowhead).

[회피] If you are targeted by Interment Construct's Entomb, cancel the cast with Feign Death (Wowhead). If you already spent Feign Death on the disease, just stay next to the crypt the group is stacked at (Topicx).
7: [차단] Take one of the other side's 2 Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge with Muzzle as well, and stop the other one with Intimidation if it is about to go through.
[광역 피해] Put the 8 Embalming Fluids into your Wildfire Bomb cones and Boomstick together. Clear Putrid Seekers poison with Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle (Emergency Salve).
9: [우선 처치] Use Takedown on the 2 Spectral Shamans and kill them first (Topicx). If a Healing Tide Totem is already out, put your Cunning pet's Mortal Wounds on the mob receiving the totem healing (Wowhead).
[차단] Split the 2 Phantom Hex Priests' Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) and Spectral Bolt between Muzzle and Intimidation (Topicx).
[광역 피해] When Royal Berserker's Bloodthirsty Axe bleeds (12 sec Physical) stack up, use Survival of the Fittest, and heal up with Exhilaration if no charge is left.
10: [우선 처치] On a four-Bloodlust route this pull is the third Bloodlust (Topicx). Kill the Ghostly Brute first with Takedown and Boomstick, though killing one Spectral Shaman first is also fine.
[회피] When you see Ghostly Brute's Seismic Upheaval cast (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby), Disengage backwards out of range. Kick the remaining Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Muzzle.
12: [위치] Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage goes to whoever engages first, so do not Harpoon in first; go in after the tank has engaged (Topicx).
[회피] If you are targeted by Dark Revelation, Disengage more than 20 yards away from the group, and take the explosion 5 sec later (473120 Shadow) with Survival of the Fittest.

1: [차단] Always kick the 2 Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield (15 sec channel, shield and CC immunity on an ally) with Muzzle (15 sec). If both channel together, stop one with Intimidation (1 min, 5 sec stun).

[제어] When the tank's Tectonic Strike stacks (25% more damage taken, 8 sec) get high, use Intimidation on the Deepstone Earthshaper so the stacks fall off (Topicx). If you spent Intimidation on a Chillweaver, leave the Earthshaper to another party member's stun.

[우선 처치] The Primal Juggernaut (CC immune) dies first (Topicx), so aim Takedown (1.5 min) and Boomstick (1 min) at the Juggernaut, and use Survival of the Fittest (1.5 min, 2 charges with Padded Armor) on Excavating Blast (106681 Nature within 60 yards plus an 8 sec DoT).
2: [차단] Kick the Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Muzzle, and kick Frostbolt when Muzzle is back.
[광역 피해] Use your remaining Survival of the Fittest charge on the Primal Juggernaut's Excavating Blast, and survive the DoT with Exhilaration (1.5 min, heals 30% of max health) if no charge is left.
3: [우선 처치] Defier Draghar (CC immune) is pulled with the pack, so throw both Wildfire Bomb charges, catch Draghar and the Earthshapers together in the Boomstick cone, and use Takedown on Draghar.
[차단] Kick the Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Muzzle, and use Intimidation on the Deepstone Earthshaper when the tank's Tectonic Strike stacks get high (Topicx).
5: [차단] Spend Muzzle on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first, and break Ashseer Flamelasher's uninterruptible Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) with the Intimidation stun (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Use Feign Death (30 sec) right before Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (3.5 sec cast, 96982 Fire within 60 yards plus a 5 sec DoT) finishes to avoid the damage (Wowhead). If Feign Death is on cooldown, use Survival of the Fittest.

[회피] When the Destroyer dies and casts Burnout (5 sec cast, 484912 Fire within 20 yards), Disengage backwards out of it. If you are targeted by Living Bomb, get more than 6 yards away from the group within 6 sec.
6: [우선 처치] Below 50% Flamegullet's Molten Blood keeps increasing party damage, so pour Takedown and Boomstick in from just before 50% and kill it fast. At +17 and above Bloodlust goes out at 50%, so line them up with it, and use your Ferocity pet's Primal Rage (6 min) if the group has no Bloodlust class (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Muzzle, and break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Intimidation.
[광역 피해] Avoid Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno with Feign Death (Wowhead), and use Survival of the Fittest once Molten Blood stacks up.
7: [차단] Put the 2 Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt into your Muzzle rotation, and break one of the 2 Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage with Intimidation. If you are the Flaming Barrage target, cancel the channel with Feign Death (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Avoid Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno with Feign Death right before the cast finishes, and Disengage out of Burnout when it dies.
8: [차단] Kick Cinderbolt with Muzzle and break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Intimidation. If both Flamelashers channel together, split them with another party member's stun.
[광역 피해] Use Feign Death or Survival of the Fittest on Inferno, and if you are targeted by Living Bomb, move away from the group in a direction away from the patrolling Thunderhead (Topicx).
10: [회피] If you are targeted by Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec), cancel the channel with Feign Death (Wowhead). If Feign Death is on cooldown, use Survival of the Fittest.
[차단] Break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Intimidation.
[광역 피해] Put the 6 Storm Warriors into your Wildfire Bomb cones and Boomstick together, and use Takedown on the Tempest Channeler.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Muzzle.
[회피] If you are targeted by Lightning Torrent, cancel it with Feign Death (Wowhead). This stretch is pulled without stopping (Topicx), so keep one Survival of the Fittest charge for Ryvati next.
12: [우선 처치] While High Channeler Ryvati's (CC immune) Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of max health) is up, the party takes Nature damage every second, and if it expires unbroken everyone within 60 yards is stunned for 4 sec. Break the shield right away with Takedown and Boomstick (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest while the shield is up, and cancel Lightning Torrent with Feign Death if you are targeted (Wowhead). If your group uses Bloodlust on Ryvati at high keys, line up Primal Rage with it (Topicx).

1: [차단] Put the 3 Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt into your Muzzle (15 sec) rotation, and never miss a kick during Sandfury Stonefist's Ground Pound (4 sec cast) (Topicx). Break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with Intimidation (1 min, 5 sec stun), and if you are the target, cancel it with Feign Death (30 sec) (Wowhead).

[우선 처치] The Sandfury Stonefist (CC immune) dies first (Topicx), so use Takedown (1.5 min) and Boomstick (1 min) on it, and use Survival of the Fittest (1.5 min, 2 charges with Padded Armor) on Ground Pound (156627 Physical within 60 yards plus a knockback).
[위치] The Shrouded Fang starts in stealth, so Harpoon in only after the tank has engaged (Topicx).
2: [위치] 2 Shrouded Fangs hide under the stairs, so do not Harpoon in ahead of the tank (Topicx).
[차단] Kick the 2 Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt with Muzzle and break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Intimidation. Use your remaining Survival of the Fittest charge on Ground Pound.
4: [우선 처치] If the Sand-Sworn Rider lives long, its Swarming Krolusks run at distant party members, so pour Takedown and Boomstick into the Rider and kill it fast (Topicx).
[해제] If you get Poisonous Viper's Cytotoxin poison (10 sec Nature DoT), clear it yourself with Feign Death (Emergency Salve, Wowhead).
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Muzzle and break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Intimidation.
5: [차단] A Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt on someone already hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin kills them (Topicx), so take one of the 2 Storm Adepts each with Muzzle and Intimidation.

[광역 피해] Once the pack is stacked, throw both Wildfire Bomb charges then Boomstick, and use Takedown on the Sand-Sworn Rider pulled in from the bridge. When Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge bleeds stack up, use Survival of the Fittest.
[해제] Clear Cytotoxin poison with Feign Death, or with Aspect of the Turtle (2 min 15 sec with Born To Be Wild and Improved Aspect of the Turtle) while Feign Death is on cooldown (Emergency Salve).
6: [차단] Put the 2 Brood Tenders' Venom Bolt into your Muzzle rotation. One person is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast) (Topicx), so spend Intimidation on a spare Venom Bolt, and if you are the Addle Mind target, cancel it with Feign Death (Wowhead).
[해제] If you get Poisonous Viper's Cytotoxin poison, clear it with Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle (Emergency Salve).
7: [해제] With 3 Poisonous Vipers, Cytotoxin keeps coming. Alternate Feign Death and Aspect of the Turtle to clear your poison (Emergency Salve, Wowhead).
[차단] Kick Brood Tender with Muzzle so Venom Bolt does not land on top of Cytotoxin (Topicx), and break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Intimidation.
9: [해제] Remove Agitated Nimbus's Accumulate Charge (8% increased damage, up to 3 stacks, Magic) with Tranquilizing Shot (10 sec) to reduce Release Charge damage.
[차단] Do not let Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt slip through while Release Charge goes off (Topicx). Split the 2 Stormcallers between Muzzle and Intimidation.
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Release Charge (145474 Nature to the whole party), and if the two Nimbuses' Release Charges alternate, take the second one with your second charge.
10: [차단] The 2 Imbued Stormcallers get kicked before the rest is gathered (Topicx), so take one each with Muzzle and Intimidation.

[광역 피해] Remove Agitated Nimbus's Accumulate Charge with Tranquilizing Shot, and use Survival of the Fittest or Exhilaration (1.5 min, heals 30% of max health) on Release Charge. Put the 4 Static Anomalies into your Wildfire Bomb cones and Boomstick together.
12: [제어] The far Temple Disruptor gets CC'd (Topicx), so drop Freezing Trap (30 sec) in its path to hold it, so you do not have to worry about it while clicking the orb (Wowhead). Kick the Essence Disruption channel of the Disruptor on the tank's side with Muzzle.

[광역 피해] Block Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (116379 Nature within 60 yards plus a 10 sec DoT) DoT with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead), or take it with Survival of the Fittest. Put the gathered Faithless Conscripts into Wildfire Bomb and Boomstick together.
13: [제어] Hold the far Temple Disruptor with Freezing Trap (Wowhead), and kick the other Disruptor's Essence Disruption with Muzzle or Intimidation to protect the orb's charge (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Use Aspect of the Turtle if you did not use it on pull 12, or Survival of the Fittest, on Caustic Stomp.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer (CC immune) must always have Flame Shock kicked, so assign Muzzle to it.

[제어] The 4 Faithless Tormentors fixate the healer, so tether them with Binding Shot (45 sec, Sentinel build) and stun one with Intimidation (Wowhead, Topicx). Since they only chase the healer, you can stay on them and hit them with Wildfire Bomb and Boomstick.
[회피] If you are targeted by Latent Hex, Disengage away from the group so the Hex Muck appears outside it.
